text.p: SA Telecommunications Inc said Friday it had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to delay filing its Form 10-QSB for the quarter ended June 30.
Results are expected to be released by August 19, it said.

The company also said Furman Selz LLC, a New York-based investment banking firm, will be its exclusive financial adviser to explore alternatives to maximize value for all stakeholders, including a sale or merger of, or a large equity investment in, the company.
SA Telecommunications said it has completed the private placement of $5 million of 10 percent convertible debentures due 2006, and received $3.3 million after discount and expenses.

As part of the transaction, the debenture and a similar debenture in the principal amount of $3.8 million, issued in March 1997, are convertible into the company's common stock at $1.50 per share with anti-dilution protections.
"This offering and the retention of Furman Selz marks the completion of the second step in the restructuring of the company following our previously announced cost reduction plan," it said.
